text:
mira (Design): Short sync on trace viewer tweaks: minimap label discoverability, export header mismatch, and copy actions. Proto: https://figma.redwood/trace-compact-2.

jon (Product): Users keep tripping over CSV headers that don't match the UI. Need a clear mapping.

kai (Eng-runtime): Plan: include {displayName, exportKey} per column so modal can show both and exports use machine keys. Persist last-used format per workspace.

ara (Accessibility): Minimap is currently SVG with no tab stops. Don't create 200 buttonsuse a single focus hotspot + arrow keys and announce via aria-live: "Span 4 of 22: db.query, duration 18ms, correlation id 0x1f2".

mira (Design): Visually show focus halo only when keyboard nav detected. Use a body class toggle.

lee (Eng-SRE): Export JSON/HAR must include correlation_id and span_id. Also add a header mapping table in the modal so our tooling knows the keys.

kai (Eng-runtime): Will precompute minimap geometry to avoid reflow and update one focus element on arrow key events. Exports will include snake_case keys and the modal mapping.

ara (Accessibility): Icon-only "copy id" needs aria-label like "Copy correlation id 0x1f2" and a live-region confirmation. In expanded mode show text "Copy ID".

mira (Design): Copy tweaks: "Save trace snapshot (PNG)", "Export events (CSV)", "Export structured trace (JSON)". I'll add a tiny "Column mapping" section in the modal.
